title: The Mixtape of Maple Street
author: K. M. Lockridge
blurb: Theo Amberdale, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
